title: Ultimate Salts On Ice Blue Slush 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blue Slush from Ultimate Puff’s On Ice collection is a sticky-sweet and super-refreshing slushy flavour with rich, bright notes of Blue Raspberry syrup with a breezy layer of icy menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices and is available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strength. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. Nicotine Salt e-liquids are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to others in Ultimate Puff’s super-refreshing On Ice collection? From classic Blue Slush on Ice to unique blends like the candy-sweet Rainbow on Ice, whatever your taste in menthol-laced e-liquid, Ultimate Puff’s On Ice has an irresistibly frosty flavour that’s just right for you.
